document: R7 RESULT — a SECOND SEARCH STRUCTURE. The mechanism transfers. (理/11552/11568)
WHICH_OF_理S_THREE_OUTCOMES: (i) FIRES. The probe is far above chance with controls flat, AND G beats the base by more than the CI on a DISJOINT 300. The mechanism is not specific to v3's pipeline grammar; it works on a clause grammar with a different verifier.

environment.verifier: the expected RESULT SET, not query text
environment.gates: P0 1.000 · P1' every task has a sibling region · prompt gate 1.000 · P3 57.3% (<=60) · k varies (4 or 5), chance PER TASK

THE_RESULT_disjoint_300.set: seed 89, ZERO signature overlap with the training seed, P3 PASSES

the_held_out_75_which_did_NOT_decide_it.reading: same direction, same size, NOT significant at n=75. Reported at the time as not deciding anything; the disjoint 300 is what decides it.

PROBE.symptom_only_lookup_table: 57.3% — and this IS P3's own statistic
PROBE.margin_over_the_table: 32 points; a reader of the symptom STRING tops out near the gate cap, so the head is reading structure rather than the string

WHAT_R7_CAN_AND_CANNOT_CONCLUDE.can: the claim is EXPERIENCE-DIRECTED SEARCH, supported on two structures rather than one — a pipeline grammar with a test-suite verifier, and a clause grammar with a result-set verifier.
WHAT_R7_CAN_AND_CANNOT_CONCLUDE.cannot: ⚠️ two environments are not 'environments in general'. Both are synthetic, both are mine, both share a harness and a verifier-decides-the-bug discipline whose blind spots would be invisible to both. That bound was written in the scope BEFORE the generator existed.

bounds: One model (Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct), head RE-FITTED from this environment's own base episodes — the mechanism transfers, not the weights.
300 per arm, paired per problem, seed 89 with zero signature overlap against the fitting seed.
P3 sits ON the boundary in this grammar (56.0-69.3% across eight seeds). seed 47 FAILED at 61.3% and its run was stopped; nothing from it is reported.
The verifier accepts ANY query returning the right rows — two queries can be equivalent.
